description: Declare an SFTP directory (or several, via paths:) as an observable external asset. The optional observation sensor only re-materializes a path when its data_version actually changes (cursor-based, not every poll), and an optional arrival check verifies a path is reachable and non-empty using the same client interface.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Dagster asset key for a single path. Mutually exclusive with `paths:` -- use this (with `remote_path:`) for one directory, or `paths:` to declare several from one component instance sharing host and one observation sensor.

remote_path.label: Remote Path
remote_path.description: Remote directory path for a single path. Mutually exclusive with `paths:`.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Declare several remote directories as external assets from one component instance, instead of one ExternalSftpPathAsset YAML block (and, with create_observation_sensor=true, one polling sensor and one SSH connection) per path. Each entry: `key` (Dagster asset key, required), `remote_path` (required), plus optional `deps`, `owners`, `metadata`, `group_name`, `description`. All entries share this component's host/port/credentials and (if enabled) ONE sensor that polls every path over a single SSH connection per tick -- set `sensor_name` explicitly when using `paths:` with create_observation_sensor=true. Mutually exclusive with the top-level `asset_key`/`remote_path` fields.

create_observation_sensor.label: Create Observation Sensor
create_observation_sensor.description: Also create the polling sensor that keeps this external asset's health/data-version current (same logic as the standalone sftp_path_observation_sensor component). When False (default), this component only declares the AssetSpec.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{asset_key}__observation_sensor' in single-path mode. Required when using `paths:` (no single path to derive a default from). Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

port.label: Port
port.description: SFTP port. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var with SFTP username. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var with SFTP password. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

private_key_env_var.label: Private Key Env Var
private_key_env_var.description: Env var with path to SSH private key. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between health checks. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key exposing `.observe(source: str) -> dict`, where source is 'host:remote_path'. Must return at least {'data_version': str}; any other keys are surfaced as event metadata (e.g. {'file_count': int}, used by check_arrival when present). Used by both the observation sensor and the arrival check. Unset uses paramiko directly.

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_arrival.label: Check Arrival
check_arrival.description: Also attach an `arrival` asset_check per path (reachable + non-empty), using the same client interface as the observation sensor. Independent of create_observation_sensor. A custom resource_key client can opt into two extra checks via observe() result keys: decrypt_ok (bool, fails the check if explicitly False) and row_count/expected_row_count (paired with row_count_tolerance_pct).

row_count_tolerance_pct.label: Row Count Tolerance (%)
row_count_tolerance_pct.description: If set, and observe() reports both row_count and expected_row_count, the arrival check fails when they differ by more than this percentage (e.g. a landed file's row count vs. a trading partner's control record). Requires a custom resource_key client -- the paramiko fallback never sets these keys.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static / multi partition types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: External SFTP Path
